facts.business: Arvaya Healthcare Limited operates an integrated healthcare platform comprising a multi-specialty hospital network under the 'SeCURE Hospitals' brand, a clinical data and intelligence platform 'SecurANT', and a patient-facing digital platform 'MyArvaya'.

auditor.name: M/s. Khire Khandekar and Kirloskar, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Intensifying competition from larger, well-capitalised hospital chains expanding into non-metro markets, and from fragmented local providers.
Dependence on the availability and retention of qualified doctors, nurses and other healthcare professionals, particularly in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets.
Delays or changes in reimbursement, package rates or empanelment under Government schemes and by insurers, which may affect revenues and working capital.
Extensive and evolving regulation of the healthcare sector, and the cost of compliance, including in relation to clinical establishments, bio-medical waste, radiation safety and data protection.
Execution and integration risk associated with recent and proposed acquisitions, and the risk that anticipated synergies are not fully realised.
